findings.title: Missed-event crash corroboration never fires in real Chrome; its basis was measured on a tab that never crashed
findings.detail: corroborateCrash needs a FRESH session to answer Performance.getMetrics on the crashed target. Real crash (Page.crash and chrome://crash): fresh session TIMEOUT 6/6 (signals.jsonl). The executor's explore-signals.json 'crash' row was taken on location.href='chrome://crash' from page JS, which its own false-pass-analysis says does NOT crash. Result: a warden started after a chrome://crash crash reports it as an unknown dialog 15/15; with the CLI warden down the gate exits 3 'unknown dialog' 5/5. Bounded: tabs/closetab still recover the same session 5/5 (no GAP-256 lock), and 'crash detection needs the warden up' is disclosed. Fix: drop the fallback or replace it (e.g. Target.getTargets/other browser-side crash state), correct the code comment and GC3.
